Calculate between-site (within study) diversity metrics

Source: R/hib_div_metrics.R
hib_calc_div_between.Rd

This function calculates a range of compositional dissimilarity/distance measures between sites (within studies) based on taxonomic diversity and for the associated HibDatabase.

Usage

hib_calc_div_between(
  obj,
  metrics,
  binary = FALSE,
  rel_abund = TRUE,
  rescale = TRUE,
  baseline_lui = "Primary vegetation_Minimal use"
)

Arguments

obj

A HibDatabase object.

metrics

Character vector of dissimilarity/distance metrics. Metrics available via vegan::vegdist: "manhattan", "euclidean", "canberra", "clark", "bray", "kulczynski", "jaccard", "gower", "altGower", "morisita", "horn", "mountford", "raup", "binomial", "chao", "cao", "mahalanobis", "chisq", "chord", "hellinger", "aitchison", "robust.aitchison". Other available metrics: "hypervolume", "cosine", "theta", "baselga_bray_balanced", "baselga_bray_gradient", "baselga_ruzicka_balanced", "baselga_ruzicka_gradient", "horn_dissim", "normalised_euclidean". Metrics can be provided in upper or lower case - internal processing is done using lower-case - and as as unambiguous abbreviations. Note: "horn" refers to the "Morisita-Horn" index in the vegan package. "horn_dissim" refers to (1 - Horn overlap), calculated endogenously within this package.

binary

Logical vector - should metric be calculated using occurence values (TRUE) or abundance (FALSE, default). Should be a single entry, or of the same length as 'metrics'. Vectors of other lengths will be recycled to the length of 'metrics'.

rel_abund

Logical vector - determining whether relative abundance should be used to calculate the dissimilarity metric, only applicable for some metrics, e.g., euclidean, hypervolume. Note: many metrics include rescaling of abundances as part of the calculation. Default values is TRUE.

rescale

Logical vector - determining if dissimilarity measure should be rescaled relative to its maximum value - applies to metrics that are not on a 0-1 scale by default - hypervolume, euclidean (if relative abundance), chord, hellinger. Default values is TRUE.

baseline_lui

Character or NULL, indicating the baseline LUI/s against which compositional dissimilarity is calculated per study. If NULL, compositional dissimilarity is calculated between all sites within each study. Default values is 'Primary vegetation_Minimal use' - the most pristine LUI within the PREDICTS database.

Value

HibDatabase with updated '$diversity_between' tibble

Details

As is standard for R6 Classes, the HibDatabase is modified in-place. If effort correction (hib_effort_correction()) has previously been conducted, diversity metrics will be estimated using effort corrected measurements.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  obj <- hib_calc_div_between(obj, 
                              c("bray", "jaccard"),
                              c(F, T),
                              c(T, F),
                              c(F, F),
                              "Primary vegetation_Minimal use")
} # }
